text:
Adam Fox has 19 assists in 17 games, and the Norris chatter has started: Yahoo Sports and Heavy.com both ran it this week. The case is better than the box score. Over his last ten he has 15 points, 13 of them assists, on 23.2 minutes a night, up 1:44, and the New York Post points to his extra power-play duties.

At five on five the Rangers take 58% of the expected goals with him on, 9.3 points better than without him, while their attempt share sits at 50.5%. Fewer shots, better ones. And the goals haven't fully followed: New York has scored 5.0 fewer than its chances deserved with Fox on the ice, so the points may have room to grow.

He was this good last season, too. Evolving-Hockey had him ninth among 215 defensemen at 2.9 wins above replacement, 99th percentile for driving offense and 94th for taking chances away. The 2021 Norris winner has two goals; shooting was never the point. Forever Blueshirts credited him with helping rescue a 3-2 comeback over the Flyers on Thursday. Our range: 71 to 99 points.
headline: Fox is building a Norris case
